calls.title: Technical Demo Herschend & Growthbook
calls.summary: The purpose of the meeting was to outline an experimentation strategy aimed at enhancing conversion rates over 20 digital properties acquired since 2020. The focus is on online ordering and mobile app purchases, driven by user experience optimization. The team currently faces limitations, conducting only one experiment per month due to resource constraints, and aims to run smaller, more targeted tests for clearer results. Key traffic insights highlighted Dollywood and Silver Dollar City as major revenue drivers, with specific conversion rates varying by property type. Growth Book was discussed as a solution for technical integration, offering flexible architecture, feature flagging, and advanced metric analysis. The team plans to evaluate Growth Book's fit in internal meetings next week, considering the metrics and features that provide the most value.
calls.keywords: Growth Book, Experimentation, Feature Flags, Umbraco CMS, Conversion Rate Optimization, Martech Integration
